title: getpack assistant
aiBody: It answers only from getpack's own data — box styles, starting prices, your orders, the glossary and help articles. It never guesses a price, a date or a policy, and conversations are not used to train models.
retention: Conversations are kept {days} days, then deleted. You can turn keeping off below.
retentionPolicy: Conversations are kept under our privacy policy. You can turn keeping off below.
empty: Try “Which mailer fits two glasses?” or “Where is order PK-2569-00125?”
signIn: The assistant can answer about your orders and prices, so please sign in first.
failed: The question was not sent. Try again.
sessionEnded: The previous conversation ended. Ask again.

unavailable.off: The AI assistant is not available yet — our team answers during business hours.
unavailable.rate_limited: Too many questions just now. Try again shortly, or talk to the team.

outcomes.blocked_unsupported_fact: The assistant could not answer this with certainty, so it did not guess.
outcomes.refused: The assistant can't help with this.
